# Extracted API contracts — Raptix UI

Snapshot: 2026-10-31. Scope: this standalone frontend only. No backend files or external services were consulted.

## Reading the evidence

- **300 unique HTTP method/path operations** on 229 OpenAPI paths; 242 shared, 13 frontend-used without a mock route, 45 mock-only; 0 confirmed compatibility-only operations. 5 HTTP operations stream SSE; WebSocket is separately counted (1).
- Frontend-used means a concrete request definition/call expression exists in application source, including exported client seams. It is NOT proof every exported method is reachable from current UI. See unused-client caveats in the gaps report.
- Explicit Zod schemas describe decoder **input** (defaults are client defaults, not server defaults). TypeScript-inferred schemas describe object construction or consumption; they do not establish runtime/server validation. Mock-confirmed responses are labeled separately.
- Required arrays in schemas denote fields in the cited type/decoder. Mock partial bodies often allow every field while handlers still reject empty values. Additional object fields are not forbidden unless a decoder explicitly says so; never infer a closed backend DTO from an interface.
- Types, unions, records, nullability and nested objects are resolved in the schema appendix/OpenAPI components. UNKNOWN leaves explain missing evidence. No empty-array fixture establishes an item contract.
- Request examples are structural illustrations from resolved types (empty strings/arrays and zero are placeholders, not guaranteed valid inputs). Multipart requests are described as form fields, not fake JSON. Response examples come from isolated fresh in-memory mocks; arrays are shortened to one item, all object fields retained.
- Status **200** means an explicit mock helper returns 200. Client-only exact success status is UNKNOWN (OpenAPI 2XX wildcard). Production errors/statuses remain UNKNOWN. Mock exception fallback: 500 {error:string}; schema failures: 400 {error:"Invalid request body"}. No claim of backend authorization enforcement.

## Transport, authentication and headers

Shared HTTP: src/platform/http.ts:34–69; VITE_API_BASE prepended, query null/undefined omitted, JSON body sets Content-Type, stored token attached unless auth:false. 401 clears session and emits session-expired; 403 emits forbidden. Raw calls return Response and feature wrappers parse/check it. Login explicitly disables auth; other operations follow the default bearer convention when a token exists. Mock spec advertises bearer except login, but src/mock/router.ts does not enforce it globally; mock Auth validates state selectively. Per-operation server permissions, rate limits and actual authentication requirements are UNKNOWN.

Same-origin legacy/raw/SSE/WS paths can bypass VITE_API_BASE. Browser multipart supplies boundary. Workflow import sends Idempotency-Key (src/features/workflows/package-client.ts:48–50). API Docs can dynamically execute spec-defined URLs; these are not an enumerable hardcoded API family (src/features/api-docs/index.ts; see gaps).

For real-time framing/lifecycle see [realtime-api-contracts.md](realtime-api-contracts.md). Machine-readable schemas: [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml). Reconciliation and limitations: [api-contract-gaps.md](api-contract-gaps.md).

**Final verification:** OpenAPI 3.1 structural validation passed; all 1,061
component schemas and 2,960 references checked; 118 request and 278 response
examples passed their extracted schemas, with supported format checks enabled.
All 300 catalog operations match the OpenAPI operation set. See the gaps report
for the executed validation record and unresolved details. A reproducible
source-extraction recipe is in [api-contract-extraction.md](api-contract-extraction.md).

<details><summary>Exact mock handler and frontend request evidence</summary>

src/mock/routes/chat.ts:251
```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/agent-loop/task-events', function (ctx) {
    const convId = M.q(ctx, 'conversationId', '');
    const run = convId ? runs[convId] : activeRuns()[0];
    if (run && !run.done) return followRun(run, ctx);
    return M.sse(function (emit, stopped) {
      return new Promise<void>(function (resolve) {
        const timer = setInterval(function () {
          if (stopped()) { clearInterval(timer); resolve(); return; }
          emit({ type: 'heartbeat', message: '', data: {} });
        }, 15000);
      });
    }, { signal: ctx.signal });
  })
```

src/features/chat/replay/attach.ts:98 (<callback>)
```ts
ports.request(url, {
          method: 'GET',
          headers: { Accept: 'text/event-stream' },
          signal: abortController.signal,
        })
```

</details>

```ts
M.route('POST', '/api/auth/login', bodies.login, function (ctx) {
    const body = ctx.body || {};
    if (!body.password) return M.fail(400, 'Password is required');
    const username = String(body.username || '').trim();
    const found = M.state.users.filter(function (u) { return u.username === username; })[0];
    if (!found) return M.fail(401, 'Incorrect password');
    if (!found.enabled) return M.fail(403, 'Account is disabled');
    M.state.sessionUserId = found.id;
    M.state.auth.token = 'mock-session-' + found.id;
    found.last_login_at = M.nowISO();
    M.save();
    return M.ok(M.sessionPayload(found));
  })
```

```ts
M.route('POST', '/api/batch-tasks', bodies.queue, function (ctx) {
    const b = ctx.body || {};
    const tasks = (b.tasks || []).map(newTask);
    const multi = M.state.config?.multi_agent;
    const backendMode = multi?.enabled && multi.batch_use_multi_agent && typeof multi.orchestration === 'string' ? multi.orchestration : 'eino_single';
    const q = {
      workflowId: b.workflowId || '',
      id: M.id('queue'), title: b.title || 'Untitled batch task', role: b.role || '', hitlPolicy: b.hitlPolicy || '',
      agentMode: backendMode, scheduleMode: b.scheduleMode || 'manual', cronExpr: b.cronExpr || '',
      scheduleEnabled: b.scheduleMode === 'cron', projectId: b.projectId || '', concurrency: b.concurrency || 1,
      tasks: tasks, status: b.executeNow ? 'running' : 'pending', createdAt: M.nowISO(), startedAt: null, completedAt: null, currentIndex: 0,
    };
    M.state.batchQueues.unshift(q);
    if (b.executeNow && q.workflowId) demoWorkflowRuns(q);
    M.save();
    return M.ok(queueView(q));
  })
```

```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/c2/tasks', function (ctx) {
    const q = ctx.query; const tasks = c2Store().tasks.filter(t => (!q.get('session_id') || t.sessionId === q.get('session_id')) && (!q.get('status') || t.status === q.get('status')) && (!q.get('task_type') || t.taskType === q.get('task_type')) && (!q.get('since') || Date.parse(t.createdAt || '') >= Date.parse(q.get('since')!)));
    const counts = { success: 0, failed: 0, pending: 0, cancelled: 0 }; for (const t of tasks) { if (t.status === 'success') counts.success++; else if (t.status === 'failed') counts.failed++; else if (t.status === 'cancelled') counts.cancelled++; else counts.pending++; }
    const size = Number(q.get('page_size')) || tasks.length; const offset = ((Number(q.get('page')) || 1) - 1) * size;
    return M.ok({ tasks: tasks.slice(offset, offset + size), total: tasks.length, status_counts: counts, pending_queued_count: c2Store().tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'queued').length });
  })
```

```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/conversations', function (ctx) {
    const projectId = M.q(ctx, 'project_id', M.q(ctx, 'projectId', ''));
    const list = M.state.conversations.filter(function (c) {
      if (projectId === '__none__' ? !!c.projectId : projectId && c.projectId !== projectId) return false;
      return M.matchSearch(c, M.q(ctx, 'search', ''), ['title']);
    });
    list.sort(function (a, b) { return a.pinned === b.pinned ? (a.updatedAt < b.updatedAt ? 1 : -1) : (a.pinned ? -1 : 1); });
    const page = M.limitOffset(list, ctx, 50);
    return M.ok({ conversations: page.items.map(function (c) { return convView(c, false); }), total: page.total, limit: page.limit, offset: page.offset });
  })
```

```ts
M.route('POST', '/api/conversations/:id/delete-turn', bodies.deleteTurn, function (ctx) {
    const convId = ctx.params.id;
    const b = ctx.body || {};
    const msgs = M.state.messages.filter(function (m) { return m.conversationId === convId; });
    const idx = msgs.findIndex(function (m) { return m.id === b.messageId; });
    if (idx === -1) return M.fail(404, 'Message not found');
    const toDrop = msgs.slice(idx).map(function (m) { return m.id; });
    M.state.messages = M.state.messages.filter(function (m) { return toDrop.indexOf(m.id) === -1; });
    M.save();
    return M.ok({ success: true, deleted: toDrop.length });
  })
```

```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/conversations/:id/plan-tasks', function (ctx) {
    const run = runs[ctx.params.id];
    if (!run || run.done) {
      return M.ok({ tasks: [], total: 0, completed: 0, activeStep: 0, running: false });
    }
    const step = Math.min(3, Math.floor(run.events.length / 6));
    const subjects = [
      { id: '1', subject: 'Scope the target', activeForm: 'Scoping the target' },
      { id: '2', subject: 'Run the tool checks', activeForm: 'Running the tool checks' },
      { id: '3', subject: 'Summarize findings', activeForm: 'Summarizing findings' },
    ];
    const tasks = subjects.map(function (t, i) {
      const status = i < step ? 'completed' : (i === step ? 'in_progress' : 'pending');
      return { id: t.id, subject: t.subject, activeForm: t.activeForm, status: status, description: '', blockedBy: [], owner: '' };
    });
    const completed = tasks.filter(function (t) { return t.status === 'completed'; }).length;
    return M.ok({ tasks: tasks, total: tasks.length, completed: completed, activeStep: Math.min(step + 1, tasks.length), running: true });
  })
```

```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/usage/tokens', function (ctx) {
    const days = Math.max(1, M.qInt(ctx, 'days', 7));
    const byDay = [];
    for (let i = days - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const key = new Date(Date.now() - i * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const base = 9000 + ((i * 2741) % 7000);
      byDay.push({ key: key, events: 4 + (i % 5), modelCalls: 3 + (i % 4), promptTokens: Math.round(base * 0.75), completionTokens: Math.round(base * 0.25), cachedTokens: Math.round(base * 0.3), cacheWriteTokens: Math.round(base * 0.05), reasoningTokens: Math.round(base * 0.1), totalTokens: base });
    }
    const byModel = [
      { key: 'demo-large', label: 'demo-large', events: 260, modelCalls: 260, promptTokens: 140200, completionTokens: 48100, cachedTokens: 52000, cacheWriteTokens: 4100, reasoningTokens: 9800, totalTokens: 188300 },
      { key: 'demo-small', label: 'demo-small', events: 152, modelCalls: 152, promptTokens: 42200, completionTokens: 13130, cachedTokens: 12000, cacheWriteTokens: 900, reasoningTokens: 0, totalTokens: 55330 },
    ];
    const summary = byModel.reduce<Record<string, number>>(function (acc, r) {
      Object.entries(r).forEach(function ([k, value]) { if (typeof value === 'number') acc[k] = (acc[k] || 0) + value; });
      return acc;
    }, {});
    summary.modelCalls = summary.modelCalls || 0;
    return M.ok({
      summary: summary,
      byDay: byDay,
      byModel: byModel,
      recent: [
        { createdAt: M.isoAgo(12), model: 'demo-large', reason: 'final', totalTokens: 7420, modelCalls: 3 },
        { createdAt: M.isoAgo(64), model: 'demo-small', reason: 'final', totalTokens: 1180, modelCalls: 1 },
        { createdAt: M.isoAgo(180), model: 'demo-large', reason: 'partial', totalTokens: 3050, modelCalls: 2 },
      ],
      days: days,
    });
  })
```

```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/chat-uploads', function (ctx) {
    const store = uploadStore();
    // Backend filters by `conversation` (internal/handler/chat_uploads.go).
    const convFilter = M.q(ctx, 'conversation', M.q(ctx, 'conversation_id', ''));
    const projFilter = M.q(ctx, 'project', M.q(ctx, 'project_id', ''));
    const nameFilter = M.q(ctx, 'name', M.q(ctx, 'search', '')).toLowerCase();
    const files = store.files.filter(function (f) {
      return (!convFilter || f.conversationId === convFilter) && (!projFilter || f.projectId === projFilter) &&
        (!nameFilter || f.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(nameFilter) !== -1);
    });
    const page = M.pagePaged(files, ctx, 20);
    return M.ok({ files: M.q(ctx, 'pageSize', '') === 'all' ? files : page.items, folders: store.folders.filter(folder => (!projFilter || folder.projectId === projFilter) && (!convFilter || folder.conversationId === convFilter)).map(folder => folder.relativePath), total: page.total, page: page.page, pageSize: page.pageSize });
  })
```

```ts
M.route('POST', '/api/chat-uploads', bodies.upload, function (ctx) {
    const names: string[] = [];
    ctx.body.getAll('file').forEach(function (f) { if (f instanceof File) names.push(f.name); });
    const convId = String(ctx.body.get('conversationId') || '');
    const dir = String(ctx.body.get('relativeDir') || '');
    const folder = uploadStore().folders.find(folder => folder.relativePath === dir);
    const conversation = M.state.conversations.find(item => item.id === (convId || folder?.conversationId || dir.split('/')[1]));
    const project = M.state.projects.find(item => item.id === conversation?.projectId);
    names.forEach(function (n) {
      const target = dir || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '/' + convId;
      uploadStore().files.unshift(uploadRecord(n, target + '/' + n, 256, conversation?.id || '', conversation?.title || '', project?.id || '', project?.name || ''));
    });
    M.save();
    return M.ok({ ok: true, uploaded: names.length });
  })
```

```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/monitor', function (ctx) {
    // Like the server, the status and tool filters narrow the list before it is paged.
    // Each entry maps an item field to the query parameter that filters it.
    const filters = { status: 'status', toolName: 'tool' };
    const list = M.filterList(M.state.executions, ctx, { searchKey: 'search', searchFields: ['toolName', 'status', 'conversationId'], filters });
    const page = M.pagePaged(list, ctx, 20);
    return M.ok({
      executions: page.items,
      summary: monitorSummary(M.state.executions),
      topTools: topTools(M.state.executions),
      timestamp: M.nowISO(),
      total: page.total,
      page: page.page,
      pageSize: page.pageSize,
      totalPages: page.totalPages,
      retentionDays: 30,
    });
  })
```

src/mock/routes/platform.ts:135
```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/openapi/spec', function () {
    const paths: Record<string, Record<string, OpenApiOperation>> = {};
    M.routes.forEach(function (r) {
      const openPath = r.pattern.replace(/:([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g, '{$1}');
      const method = r.method.toLowerCase();
      const tag = (r.pattern.split('/')[2] || 'misc');
      const operations = paths[openPath] ??= {};
      const params = (r.pattern.match(/:[A-Za-z0-9_]+/g) || []).map(function (p) {
        return { name: p.slice(1), in: 'path', required: true, schema: { type: 'string' } };
      });
      operations[method] = {
        tags: [tag],
        summary: r.method + ' ' + r.pattern,
        operationId: (r.method + '_' + r.pattern).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, '_'),
        parameters: params,
        responses: { '200': { description: 'OK (demo response)' } },
        security: r.pattern === '/api/auth/login' ? [] : [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
      };
    });
    return M.ok({
      openapi: '3.0.3',
      info: { title: 'Raptix UI mock', version: 'v1.7.24', description: 'Endpoints answered by the standalone demo runtime. Data is fictional.' },
      servers: [{ url: '/' }],
      paths: paths,
      components: { securitySchemes: { bearerAuth: { type: 'http', scheme: 'bearer' } } },
    });
  })
```

```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/projects/:id/facts', function (ctx) {
    let list = projectFacts(ctx.params.id);
    const q = M.q(ctx, 'q', M.q(ctx, 'search', ''));
    if (q) list = list.filter(function (f) { return M.matchSearch(f, q, ['fact_key', 'summary', 'body', 'category']); });
    if (M.q(ctx, 'category', '')) list = list.filter(function (f) { return f.category === M.q(ctx, 'category', ''); });
    if (M.q(ctx, 'confidence', '')) list = list.filter(function (f) { return f.confidence === M.q(ctx, 'confidence', ''); });
    if (M.q(ctx, 'hide_deprecated', '') === 'true') list = list.filter(function (f) { return !f.deprecated; });
    if (M.q(ctx, 'exclude_deprecated', '') === 'true') list = list.filter(f => !f.deprecated);
    if (M.q(ctx, 'related_vulnerability_id', '')) list = list.filter(f => f.related_vulnerability_id === M.q(ctx, 'related_vulnerability_id', ''));
    return M.ok(list);
  })
```

```ts
    if (!f) return M.fail(404, 'Fact not found');
    M.mergeInto(f, ctx.body, ['summary', 'body', 'category', 'confidence', 'pinned', 'fact_key']);
    f.updated_at = M.nowISO();
    M.save();
    return M.ok(f);
  })
```

```ts
    return M.ok({ vulnerabilities: rows, total: list.length, page: page.page, page_size: pageSize, total_pages: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(list.length / pageSize)) });
  })
```

```ts
M.route('POST', '/api/vulnerabilities/:id/retest', bodies.prompt, function (ctx) {
    const found = M.findById(M.state.vulnerabilities, ctx.params.id);
    if (!found) return M.fail(404, 'Vulnerability not found');
    const source = M.findById(M.state.conversations, found.item.conversation_id)?.item;
    if (!source) return M.fail(400, 'Retest requires a source conversation');
    const prompt = ctx.body.prompt?.trim();
    if (!prompt) return M.fail(400, 'A verification prompt is required');
    const conversation = { ...source, id: M.id('conv'), title: `Retest: ${found.item.title}`, createdAt: M.nowISO(), updatedAt: M.nowISO() };
    M.state.conversations.unshift(conversation);
    M.state.messages.filter(message => message.conversationId === source.id).forEach(message => M.state.messages.push({ ...message, id: M.id('msg'), conversationId: conversation.id }));
    M.save();
    return M.ok({ conversation, prompt });
  })
```

src/mock/routes/security.ts:318
```ts
M.route('GET', '/api/vulnerabilities/export', function (ctx) {
    const list = filteredVulnerabilities(ctx);
    if (M.q(ctx, 'mode', '') === 'summary') {
      const groups = new Map<string, Vulnerability[]>();
      list.forEach(v => { const key = v.conversation_id || 'standalone'; groups.set(key, [...(groups.get(key) || []), v]); });
      return M.ok({ files: [...groups].map(([key, items]) => ({ filename: `findings-${key}.md`, content: items.map(v => formatMarkdown(v, translateRuntime, 'en-US')).join('\n\n---\n\n') })) });
    }
    const format = M.q(ctx, 'format', 'json');
    if (format === 'csv') {
      const header = 'id,title,severity,status,target';
      const rows = list.map(function (v) { return [v.id, v.title, v.severity, v.status, v.target].map(function (c) { return '"' + String(c).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; }).join(','); });
      return M.blob([header].concat(rows).join('\n'), 'text/csv', 'vulnerabilities-demo.csv');
    }
    return M.blob(JSON.stringify({ vulnerabilities: list }, null, 2), 'application/json', 'vulnerabilities-demo.json');
  })
```

```ts
    const w = M.state.workflows.filter(function (x) { return x.id === ctx.params.id; })[0];
    if (!w) return M.fail(404, 'Workflow not found');
    const b = ctx.body || {};
    M.mergeInto(w, b, ['name', 'description', 'enabled']);
    const graph = b.graph_json || b.graph;
    if (graph) w.graph_json = graph;
    w.version = (w.version || 1) + 1;
    w.updated_at = M.nowISO();
    M.save();
    return M.ok(wfView(w));
  })
```

```ts
  })
```

src/mock/routes/platform.ts:511
```ts
M.route('POST', '/api/workflows/runs/:runId/resume', z.object({ approved: z.boolean(), comment: z.string().optional() }), function (ctx) {
    const found = M.state.workflowRuns?.find(r => r.run.id === ctx.params.runId); if (!found) return M.fail(404, 'Run not found');
    if (found.run.status !== 'awaiting_hitl') return M.fail(400, 'Run is not awaiting approval');
    found.run.status = ctx.body.approved ? 'completed' : 'rejected'; found.run.finished_at = M.nowISO(); found.run.output_json = JSON.stringify({ result: 'Demo workflow execution' });
    found.nodeRuns.forEach(n => { n.status = ctx.body.approved ? 'completed' : 'rejected'; n.finished_at = M.nowISO(); }); M.save();
    const input = z.object({ queueId: z.string().optional(), taskId: z.string().optional() }).parse(JSON.parse(found.run.input_json) as unknown);
    const queue = M.state.batchQueues.find(q => q.id === input.queueId), task = queue?.tasks.find(t => t.id === input.taskId);
    if (task && queue) { task.status = ctx.body.approved ? 'completed' : 'cancelled'; task.completedAt = M.nowISO(); task.result = 'Demo workflow execution'; if (!queue.tasks.some(t => t.status === 'running' || t.status === 'pending')) { queue.status = 'completed'; queue.completedAt = M.nowISO(); } }
    M.save();
    return M.ok({ workflowRunId: found.run.id, status: found.run.status });
  })
```
